definitions.event: first accepted step of each summary generation (first use of that summary)
definitions.step1: category of the first tool call in the first accepted step after first use
definitions.three: first three accepted steps of the generation; events whose generation ended earlier are excluded
definitions.baseline: accepted steps at position 4 or later within any generation
definitions.reread: first tool call is inspect_only and every static path it reads appeared in a tool call of the previous 20 accepted steps (lexical paths only)
definitions.aggregation: events averaged within run; runs weighted equally; paired S-A differences by model/task/threshold/repetition; bootstrap over runs or pairs
